doctrine: Task-shaped operating points, not cheap/default/max ladders
Enumerate and explain; no silent auto-routing
Quota and API dollars are non-fungible

Model swapped gpt-5.6-sol → gpt-6-astra and effort xhigh → high on policy basis (never xhigh/max by default); the cited terminal-bench-4-astra-audit-2026-09 evidence is graded C (secondary/indirect board read, comparable=false) — evidence_confidence held at medium, not raised, on the model swap alone

Rule conflict (2026-09-22): 'checker at least as strong as maker' and 'different model family' cannot both hold while Opus 5.5 is the strongest maker. GPT-6 Astra high beats Opus 5.5 medium on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and loses on FrontierCode (vendor charts). Kept on the strongest different-family model.

Moved codex/gpt-6-astra/high -> codex/gpt-6.1-sol/high on 2026-09-30 (best guess: Astra at $10/$50 per MTok is not worth its price for routine audits; GPT-6.1 Sol is $2/$10 and OpenAI describes it as near-Astra). No independent audit-recall evidence exists for either model; AA Intelligence Index v4.3.2 has GPT-6.1 Sol high at 50.2 for $0.32/task. Astra stays available by explicit flag for security-sensitive or disputed reviews. A seeded-defect local eval is the deciding evidence and is pending.
